en.name: Ear Reshaping (Otoplasty)
en.meta_title: Otoplasty (Ear Reshaping): Surgical Correction for Prominent Ears
en.meta_description: Correct prominent or misshapen ears with otoplasty surgery. This procedure reshapes and repositions the ears closer to the head for a more balanced facial appearance and a significant boost in self-confidence.
en.meta_keywords: otoplasty, ear reshaping surgery, prominent ear correction, ear pinning, cosmetic ear surgery, plastic surgery for ears

what_is.heading: What is Otoplasty? Bringing Balance to Your Features
paragraphs: Otoplasty, or ear reshaping surgery, is a procedure designed to correct the size, shape, or position of the ears. It is most commonly performed to address prominent ears that stick out too far from the head, but can also correct overly large or misshapen ears. This procedure can have a profound impact on self-confidence for both adults and children.

procedure.heading: The Otoplasty Procedure
paragraphs: Our skilled surgeons focus on creating natural-looking contours that bring balance to the face. We take care to place incisions discreetly in the natural creases behind the ear to minimize visible scarring. The surgery involves sculpting the cartilage of the ear to create a more desirable shape and pinning it back closer to the head with internal, permanent sutures.

candidates_recovery.heading: Candidates and Recovery
paragraphs: For children, the procedure can be performed after the age of five. For adults, there is no upper age limit. Recovery from otoplasty is relatively quick. A protective dressing is worn for a few days, followed by a supportive headband worn at night for several weeks. Most patients can return to work or school within one week, feeling renewed confidence.
